w: After concluding his morning puja, Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha rituals of pujan and arti of deities to be installed in BAPS hari mandirs in Memnagar (Amdavad), Odhav (Amdavad), Khoraj and Sector 22, Gandhinagar.

At about 10.00 am Swamishri performed the foundation-stone laying ceremony of ‘Jivan Sandhya Kutir’ (home for senior citizens) and also inaugurated the newly built student’s hostel called ‘Ishavasyam Chhatralay’ of Hiramani Vidyalay in Chharodi on the outskirts of Amdavad. Thereafter Swamishri addressed the assembly of dignitaries and blessed Shri Narharibhai Amin, the president and proprietor of the Hiramani Educational Trust.
Swamishri performed the arti of Thakorji on the mandir’s 10th consecration anniversary celebration (patotsav). In the evening assembly Swamishri discoursed about worshipping God from a young age.
Two BAPS sadhus and 25 youths, and 5 devotees from Dudhvala pilgrimaged by foot.

Pramukh Swami Maharaj was busy in a meeting. The meeting could not be finished by the time of his walk, and yet Swamishri wished to finish the meeting today even by cancelling his walk, because the sadhus involved had to leave. Swamishri was thinking of them first.

When it was time, Yogicharan Swami and Dr Nikul came to Swamishri. They measured Swamishri's BP and checked his pulse, and it did not seem right to them. In this situation a walk was certainly not possible, but holding the meeting was not possible either, because giving decisions in a meeting requires a lot of mental exertion. Yet Swamishri said, "Let us finish the meeting now."
Yogicharan Swami said, "Right now you need rest."
Swamishri said, "But what about all these who have to leave? So let us finish the work."
Yogicharan Swami called all the sadhus who were to leave and asked, "Do you have to leave right now?"
All the sadhus said, "No, Bapa! We are in no hurry; we will stay." So Swamishri accepted.
Even in such a physical condition, Swamishri thinks of others first.
Today, during the conversation at the midday meal, Atmaswarupdas Swami asked, "Swami! Have you ever sung a kirtan?"

"Yes, I sang 'Swamishri to Mahapratapi...' at Yogibapa's command. He commanded me twice; once I sang this and the other time I sang 'Sambhal beni Hari rizyani ritdi...'" Saying this, Mahant Swami Maharaj added, "I like kirtans very much, but I did not sing them."
At this time the sadhus asked, "Are there any incidents of Yogibapa's love that you cannot forget?"

In reply Swamishri said, "Yogibapa was going from Viramgam to Mumbai. At a quarter to ten at night the train came to Anand station. There were about twenty five devotees. Everyone went to meet Yogibapa, but I was shy, so I stood away, leaning against something. Someone told Bapa, 'Vinu Bhagat is there.' (So) Bapa got up, got off and came to me and gave me loving pats. After that, for a month, I went there every day and remembered it."
Then, speaking of another incident, he said, "I often got the privilege of lifting Yogibapa (from his chair). (While being helped up) Bapa would hang on my two arms."
Thus, by telling incidents of unforgettable love, Swamishri drenched everyone in the joy of memories.

Mahant Swami Maharaj was going from his residence towards the dining hut when Kikani Saheb was standing on the path with two rudraksha saplings. He requested Swamishri, "Place flowers on these and sanctify them. We will plant them here."
Swamishri's eyes fell on the saplings, and immediately drawing attention to it, he said, "Pull out that blade of grass."
A small blade of grass had sprouted from the black bag of one sapling. The sadhus marvelled at Swamishri's keen eye.
